Use with caution / monitor

The concomitant use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents (such as ibuprofen) and corticosteroids (such as prednisone) increases the risk of gastrointestinal side effects, including a substantially increased risk of gastrointestinal bleeding [prednisone:drug_interactions:5, ibuprofen:warnings:8]. Patients with a prior history of peptic ulcer disease or gastrointestinal bleeding are at an even greater risk when these agents are combined [ibuprofen:warnings:8].
